adjudication.rationale:
In TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve, when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true it calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline (synchronously) before falling back to `fetch_http`.

This path is reached from the user-triggered `EmbedController#best` flow: when no embed is found, it enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` with `embed_url`, and that job calls `TopicRetriever.new(args[:embed_url], no_throttle: user.try(:staff?)).retrieve`. The only throttle in `TopicRetriever` is `retrieved_recently?`, which keys by `@embed_url` for 60 seconds, and is fully bypassed when `no_throttle` is true (staff users). Therefore, staff-triggered requests can cause synchronous full feed polling on every invocation, and non-staff can still trigger it once per URL per 60s. This matches the finding and is a real behavior/performance defect introduced by the diff.
